✨ Finally, my V Cola booth design is complete!

Inspired by Ancient Egyptian heritage and the Grand Egyptian Museum, I designed a 3×3 m booth that blends cultural identity with a modern experience.

The concept is inspired by pyramid forms and the colors of Tutankhamun’s mask. It includes a tasting area, a photo corner, a digital screen, and a product display, with animated lighting and AI-generated motion scenes to bring the experience to life.

Designed by: DK designs 🤎✨

✨ وأخيرًا خلصت تصميم بووث V Cola!

استوحيت الفكرة من الحضارة المصرية القديمة والمتحف المصري الكبير، وصممت بووث بمساحة 3×3 متر يجمع بين الهوية المصرية والطابع العصري.

التصميم مستوحى من شكل الأهرامات وألوان تمثال توت عنخ آمون، وبيضم منطقة تذوق، ركن للتصوير، شاشة عرض ومنطقة لعرض المنتجات، مع إضاءة متحركة ومشاهد بالذكاء الاصطناعي علشان التجربة تكون أكثر تفاعلًا وحيوية.

#360 - A flag on a can became the spark for a nationwide movement.
Ahead of the World Cup, V cola is rallying Egyptians across the country to proudly raise Egypt’s flag in a collective show of unity and national pride.
What began with the Egyptian flag appearing on V Cola cans and distribution fleets has grown beyond a single brand, with businesses, communities, and organizations across Egypt embracing the movement. Talabat and Seoudi were among the first to join, helping spread the message far and wide.
Today, the movement continues to grow, turning a simple symbol into a nationwide expression of pride that reaches every corner of Egypt.
One flag. One message. One Egypt.

What started with V Cola on a can grew bigger with Seoudi on a bag.
From one brand to another.
From one street to the next.
One flag, carried further every step of the way.

Now Seoudi is inviting Spuds and Zabado to join in.

Let’s raise Egypt’s flag.

V Lemon continues to lean into the classic white soda taste that generations already know well, combining the real taste of lemon with a light, fizzy feel in every can, a familiar taste that’s long been part of the white soda scene.

With more fizz, more lemon flavour, and 100% natural flavouring, the drink keeps things light and simple while staying caffeine-free. The refreshed look also brings a more modern feel to a drink that many already know well.

As a proudly-made Egyptian product that meets world-class standards, V Lemon continues to lean into the kind of classic taste that generations have grown up on.

#EatsAD: V Lemon occupy a very specific social category in Egypt known as “the drink your mother buys in bulk and considers morally safe.”

Now, V Lemon is leaning into what people want from a lemon soda. The central message is refreshingly direct: real lemon taste, 100% natural flavour, enriched with vitamins and exactly the kind of sharp citrus hit people want from a lemon soda after an extremely large meal.

The drink leans into stronger citrus flavour, and a caffeine-free formula designed for exactly the kinds of situations Egyptians routinely find themselves in: extremely hot weather, extremely large meals, or both simultaneously. V Lemon also continues to position itself as the sort of white soda mothers approve of, which in Egypt is less a marketing category and more a nationally recognised certification process.

V Lemon remains proudly Egyptian while produced to world-class standards, which means the soda still serves the same basic purpose it always has: helping people recover emotionally from lunch.
